steps.title: Read the checklist
steps.body: "What going live needs": six items with links.
steps.expect: Two-factor sign-in Done (or Missing), live Amadeus Missing until requested, others "Checked when you go live".

steps.title: Try the switch
steps.body: **Go live** → "Switch your storefront to live?" → Confirm → step-up code.
steps.expect: Refused with "N requirements are missing, so nothing has changed" naming exactly `details.missing`; `tenants.storefront_environment` still `test`.

steps.title: Meet the preconditions
steps.body: Live Amadeus office assigned, live payments (Velexis + verified payout account, or Connect), plan with `liveMode`, current subscription (Stripe trialing/active or manual `active`), MFA on.
steps.expect: Each link leads to the page that completes it.

steps.title: Go live
steps.expect: "Your storefront is live", takes effect within 60 s; `storefront_environment = 'live'`, `live_enabled_at` set; API keys page shows a Live keys tab.
